title: bug: JetBrains board ignores revision-only plan updates
description: MoeToolWindowPanel updateBoard and updateColumn fingerprints omit planRevision and step descriptions (lines 462–464, 706–708). A plan edit that only changes step text/revision skips rebuilding cards and leaves the rendered approval snapshot stale until some other field changes; CQ-F04c safely sends the old revision, so daemon CAS refuses it. Include plan revision in both fingerprints and cover revision-only refresh.
definitionOfDone: Revision-only plan updates refresh the board and column snapshots; regression tests cover the refresh without unrelated task field changes.

Add source-wiring assertions proving both updateBoard and updateColumn use this helper before their cache early-return, and retain existing approvalFingerprint cross-column/rendered-token guards unchanged. No full IDE construction or duplicated test-side fingerprint implementation.

implementationPlan.description: Create a small internal pure function in BoardTaskFingerprint.kt (proposed name boardTaskFingerprint(tasks: List<Task>): String). Move the duplicated task-string construction into it preserving every existing input and join order, then include nullable planRevision explicitly and step.description alongside stepId/status. Use it at BOTH existing taskFingerprint sites in MoeToolWindowPanel. Keep board runCatching/error handling (warn then rebuild), column key approvalFingerprint/epic/WIP/collapse/sort inputs, empty-cache behavior and captured rendered tasks unchanged. No new public API, dependencies, model fields or runtime data fetch. Add one inline why-comment about revision-only snapshot invalidation.

implementationPlan.note: Adversarial review of own diff (3 paths; ~567 other dirty paths untouched). (1) Revision-only edit: rev= is now in the outer boardFingerprint, so updateBoard no longer early-returns; updateColumn keys also carry rev= plus the unchanged approvalFingerprint, so source and destination columns both rebuild and recapture the new rendered Task. (2) Unchanged snapshots produce the identical string and still skip. (3) null/0/present render "null"/"0"/"N", distinct. (4) Step-text-only edits change stepFp. (5) All prior inputs/order kept; runCatching warn-then-rebuild and the column try/catch force-rebuild untouched. (6) Wiring test pins both real call sites by index-before-early-return; an unused helper gives indexOf=-1 and fails. (7) Concurrency: pure function, all on EDT. Theoretical only: delimiter chars in step/task text could in principle collide across fields, same as the pre-existing title/description inputs; change-detector only, no security role. Non-awaiting tasks whose revision changes now also refresh their column (correct: only on plan edits). No code change after the green gate, so no rerun needed. comments.content: CQ-F04c self-review fixed a related in-scope issue: unchanged destination-column callbacks could retain a task's old PLANNING status and send token-free UPDATE_TASK after the source became AWAITING_APPROVAL. Every column key now includes visible awaiting ids + revisions via approvalFingerprint. This follow-up still needs the OUTER boardFingerprint to recognize revision-only plan edits (it can early-return before that column processing); preserve rendered-token semantics and add a refresh regression.

completionSummary: JetBrains board now refreshes on revision-only (and step-text-only) plan updates.
